aggregation_contract.level_pass_condition: every required gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.local_beta_verified_condition: every L0-L5 level must equal passed
aggregation_contract.github_released_condition: local_beta_verified plus every required_for_github_release gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.skipped_policy: skipped is forbidden and must never aggregate to passed

gates.description: Acceptance execution uses a fresh temporary runtime and does not reuse project runs.
Acceptance runs from a clean worktree whose exact 40-character commit can bind browser, restart and cold-clone evidence.
Requirements, Loop state and gate definitions are readable and use the declared status contract.
Python package, server and Node adapter identify the same v0.7 Beta version.
Health and OpenAPI respond successfully from a fresh application instance.
The complete Python and DeepSeek Harness adapter suites pass.
The built-in Recipe and Data Adapter registry matches the declared baseline without implying dynamic audio support.
Ambiguous OCR or recognition requests cannot create data, Recipe or Run objects before clarification.
Clarification appends an immutable TaskSpec revision while preserving task_id across restart.
List, detail and write responses expose one authoritative current stage, blockers and next action.
Two task drafts remain isolated across switching and browser reload.
Agent cancellation and task-owned Run cancellation remain separate and restart-safe.
Stale revisions, cross-task cancellation and offline Agent failures do not mutate task or Run lineage.
Audio samples are staged persistently without becoming a DatasetVersion or Run.
Traversal, symlink, encryption, decompression and malformed WAV inputs fail closed with queryable evidence.
BuildAttempt transitions, events, cancellation and validating-state restart recovery are persistent.
Only the trusted audio RecipeSpec is accepted and every Python or executable build is blocked.
Registration requires explicit approval, validation, exact digests and the current TaskSpec revision.
The same audio task resumes after registration, trains a real model, deep-verifies artifacts and survives restart.

The official huggingface_hub client downloads the declared public immutable commit and the same asset lineage completes real training, a 20-sample test evaluation, new-sample inference, bundle verification and application restart.
A product API exposes Hugging Face repository, immutable revision, Model Card, license, files and local compatibility.
Downloads require approval and a resolved immutable commit; rejection produces no cache or lineage.
Ephemeral credentials never persist; license and per-file hashes persist; tampering quarantines the asset.
Selected ModelAsset identity is frozen into TrainingTask and TrainingContract lineage, or trained-from-scratch is explicit.
Training exposes backend events, measured duration, resource evidence, candidates and logs without simulated progress.
Restart recovers interrupted staging safely without activating partial payloads.
Run completion, integrity, metric gates and evidence sufficiency produce separate conclusions.
Image, tabular and audio Runs each persist an EvaluationReport bound to task, Run and model hashes.
Candidate evidence, failure samples, thresholds and parent-child Run history are inspectable.
A user can submit a new raw image, row or WAV and reopen its hash-bound InferenceCheck.
Tampered or unsupported model artifacts create persistent blocked inference evidence.
The delivery bundle is atomic, hashed, restart-safe and excludes raw/private/internal data.
Integrated rejection, failure, cancellation, disconnect, tamper and restart paths all retain auditable objects.
Image, tabular and audio product journeys each complete training, evaluation, inference and bundle delivery.
The complete product journey passes at 1440x900 with clean Console and Network evidence.
The complete product journey passes at 390x844 with reachable Context/results, no overflow and 44px targets.
A real service-process restart preserves task, build, asset, Run, evaluation, inference and bundle identities.
A clean checkout of the exact release commit installs and reproduces the minimal loop without existing local state.
No required gate or declared P0 remains failed or blocked.
Commit, push, PR, CI, merge, tag and GitHub Release are independently evidenced; this gate does not rewrite local Beta verification.
